patterns.name: RAG Pattern
patterns.shortDesc: The RAG pattern includes an indexing flow that loads text data into a vector database, and a REST API flow that retrieves relevant information from the vector database to enrich AI-generated responses. Note: The pattern is only supported on IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.5.0 and above.
